notes.title: Fallen Hunter is 20% Off for Two Weeks!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Hunters,
We’re running our first discount for [i]Fallen Hunter[/i]! For the next two weeks you can grab the game at [b]20% off[/b].[/p][p]If you’ve been waiting to dive in, now’s the perfect time. Explore the story of two hunters, fight your way through corrupted lands, and uncover the truth behind the Fallen.[/p][p]Sale runs from [b]09 September[/b] to [b]02 October[/b].[/p][p]Thanks so much for the support. If you’re enjoying the game, sharing it with a friend or leaving a review helps us more than you can imagine.[/p][p]See you in the hunt [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3679520/Fallen_Hunter/" style="button" buttoncolor="#140000"]Fallen Hunter[/url]
GrimHawk[/p]

notes.title: Community Feedback: Report Bugs & Share Suggestions
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Hunters,[/p][p]Your feedback is [b]crucial[/b] to help us improve [i]Fallen Hunter[/i].
If you’ve found [b]bugs/technical issues[/b] or have [b]feature suggestions[/b], please post them here:
 --- [b]Official “Bugs & Suggestions” thread:[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3679520/discussions/0/802322896293830680/" style="button" buttoncolor="#350303"]Share Bugs & Suggestions Here[/url][/p][p]We read [b]every comment[/b] and will prioritize fixes based on your reports.
Thank you for your support. No game is perfect at launch, and your input truly helps us make it better.[/p][p]The [i]Fallen Hunter[/i] Team[/p][p][b]Tip:[/b] please include your system specs (CPU, GPU, RAM, OS), the area/mission where it happened, and screenshots or a short video if possible.[/p]
